narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -7.47 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 854.56-856.04 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 867.43; the first objective pays 1.44R at 849.81.

plan.triggerRule: footprint exh fired sell in short direction at the zone
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 867.43 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
vetoes: M1 R 1.44 < 1.5 — reward does not pay the risk
